t: An open 3D-printed robot arm pair for teaching robots by example.
steps: Read the parts list in the jess-moss koch-v1-1 repo on GitHub and the LeRobot Koch guide.
Choose your path. The DIY parts list totals about 477 US dollars for both arms, plus 3D printing.
Or buy the Robotis leader and follower servo kits for about 205 and 213 US dollars each.
Print the arm parts from the STL files or use a print service.
Assemble both arms with the wiring diagram and the assembly video.
Install the LeRobot Python library on your computer.
Set each servo ID one at a time with the lerobot-setup-motors tool.
Calibrate both arms and try teleoperation with the leader arm.
meta: Wild Open. From $205. A few stores.
